passwords_one_way_hashed.title: Passwords One-Way Hashed
passwords_one_way_hashed.description: Every stored password is protected by a one-way adaptive KDF (Argon2id/scrypt/bcrypt/PBKDF2) so the secret cannot be recovered; fires is_false (plaintext or reversibly-encrypted storage). Consolidates the inverse framing passwords_stored_plaintext_or_reversible.

adaptive_memory_hard_hash_used.title: Adaptive / Memory-Hard Hash Used
adaptive_memory_hard_hash_used.description: Stored passwords use a memory-hard/adaptive KDF (Argon2id preferred); fires is_false on a fast/unsalted digest (MD5/SHA-1/raw SHA-256).

per_credential_salt_used.title: Per-Credential Salt Used
per_credential_salt_used.description: Each credential carries a unique random salt (>=32 bits); fires is_false (missing or shared salt enables rainbow tables).

adequate_work_factor.title: Adequate KDF Work Factor
adequate_work_factor.description: KDF cost meets OWASP minimums (Argon2id m>=19MiB t>=2; bcrypt>=10; PBKDF2>=600k); fires is_false (speed-tuned or below floor).

secrets_stored_in_dedicated_secret_manag.title: Secrets In Dedicated Secret Manager
secrets_stored_in_dedicated_secret_manag.description: Long-lived API/SSH/private keys held in a managed vault and injected at runtime; fires is_false.

secrets_hardcoded_in_config_or_iac.title: Secrets Hardcoded In Config / IaC
secrets_hardcoded_in_config_or_iac.description: Plaintext keys/tokens in tracked config/.env/IaC/image layers; fires is_true.

tls_only_transport.title: TLS-Only Transport
tls_only_transport.description: Credentials transmitted exclusively over TLS; login/auth endpoints HTTPS-only with HTTP redirected; fires is_false.

hsts_enforced.title: HSTS Enforced
hsts_enforced.description: HSTS header on authenticated responses defeats SSL-strip/downgrade; fires is_false.

rate_limiting_or_lockout_enabled.title: Rate Limiting / Lockout Enabled
rate_limiting_or_lockout_enabled.description: Failed-auth attempts throttled or account locked (account-bound); fires is_false (unlimited guessing).

breached_password_screening_enabled.title: Breached-Password Screening Enabled
breached_password_screening_enabled.description: New/changed passwords screened against a breached/common-password corpus (Pwned Passwords k-anonymity) and rejected; fires is_false. Referenced by both the brute-force and credential-strength-policy rules.

mfa_available.title: MFA Available
mfa_available.description: A second factor (TOTP/WebAuthn/possession) available and enforced for sensitive access; fires is_false (password-only).

max_consecutive_failed_attempts.title: Max Consecutive Failed Attempts
max_consecutive_failed_attempts.description: Cap on consecutive failed attempts before lockout/throttle; fires gt 100 (NIST 800-63B ceiling).

generic_failure_responses.title: Generic Failure Responses
generic_failure_responses.description: Failed-auth returns a single generic message for all failure modes (no user-exists disclosure); fires is_false.

constant_time_login_responses.title: Constant-Time Login Responses
constant_time_login_responses.description: Login handling takes comparable time for valid vs invalid usernames (no timing side channel); fires is_false.

password_min_length.title: Password Minimum Length
password_min_length.description: Enforced minimum password length; fires lt 8 (NIST floor; 15 without MFA).

password_max_length_cap_below_64.title: Password Max-Length Capped Below 64
password_max_length_cap_below_64.description: Policy caps max length <64 OR strips/blocks characters (prevents passphrases); fires is_true.

composition_rules_or_forced_rotation_imp.title: Composition Rules / Forced Rotation Imposed
composition_rules_or_forced_rotation_imp.description: Mandatory composition rules OR forced periodic rotation imposed (NIST says SHOULD NOT); fires is_true.

key_rotation_enabled.title: Key Rotation Enabled
key_rotation_enabled.description: Long-lived API/SSH/private keys have a documented, tested rotation lifecycle; fires is_false.

forced_reset_or_revocation_on_compromise.title: Forced Reset / Revocation On Compromise
forced_reset_or_revocation_on_compromise.description: Documented, tested path to revoke/reissue a leaked credential AND force password reset on evidence of compromise; fires is_false.

secrets_masked_in_logs.title: Secrets Masked In Logs
secrets_masked_in_logs.description: Passwords/keys/auth-headers redacted at emission before logs; fires is_false.

transmitted_in_url_or_query.title: Transmitted In URL Or Query
transmitted_in_url_or_query.description: Credential/secret placed in a URL path/query string (leaks via logs/referrer/history); fires is_true.

least_privilege_access_enforced.title: Least-Privilege Access Enforced
least_privilege_access_enforced.description: Read/management access to the credential/hash table and secret store restricted to the auth-service identity (least-privilege); fires is_false.

pepper_stored_separately.title: Pepper Stored Separately
pepper_stored_separately.description: Server-side pepper (>=112-bit) held in a separate secret manager/HSM, not beside the hashes; fires is_false (no pepper or co-located).
